v1_disposition.reason: The horizontal-only trace implementation failed on five raw frames whose printed lines are vertically oriented.

evidence.observation: W007, W016, W017, W041, and W042 show a vertical dark line while the v1 path runs horizontally.

v1_disposition.prohibition: Do not report v1 endpoint values.

scope: Orientation-aware RAW centreline freeze and printed nominal apparent-width measurement

claim_boundary.allowed: Printed-target nominal apparent-width preservation under the acquisition-system design GSD
forbidden: Traceable physical metrology of the printed target
Using nominal line widths to calibrate pixel-to-mm scale

calibration.interpretation: Assumption/sensitivity basis, not an independent board-dimension calibration

orientation_rule.selection: Maximum median SNR of the continuous dynamic-programming trace
orientation_rule.future_variant_rule: Reuse the selected RAW trace and orientation unchanged for every co-registered variant

sampling_rule.reason: At 0.3 mm/sensor pixel, the nominal spans are 0.33 and 0.67 pixel; no PSF deconvolution is used.

measurement.apparent_width_definition: FWHM between linearly interpolated half-maximum edge crossings
measurement.rectification: Frozen ROI quadrilateral to an equal-sided plane while retaining inverse-homography local normal scale
measurement.design_gsd_application: Rectified normal width is mapped back to sensor-pixel distance before multiplication by 0.3 mm/pixel
measurement.aggregation: Median retained profile width per ROI

fixed_parameters.uncertainty_non_estimable_rule: 95% statistical CI span greater than 0.5 times nominal width
